svg.text: 10 servers · many services · ~100k active series · 15s scrape · 90d retention
Vector: prometheus_scrape → filter → remap (service · instance · env · version) → tag_cardinality_limit → disk buffer
Monitoring VM · 4 CPU · 8–16 GB RAM · SSD
Every series carries service · instance · env · version labels
RED per service: http_requests_total · http_request_duration_seconds (shared buckets)
